notes: Bible 6.2: the Gilded Tern's shanghai route (3.6, 5.14). Reed trades it for the toll in reed-kestrel-lock.
text: The Gilded Tern pays double for crew who don't ask what's in the hold.

secondHand.text: Lock-keepers say the Gilded Tern pays double for crew who don't ask what's in the hold. Don't you go signing on.
